claims.text: It = reasonable to add bempedoic acid to a statin, w or w.o ezetimibe and/or a PCSK9 mAb, to reach LDL-C <55 mg/dL.
claims.quote: it is reasonable to add bempedoic acid to a statin, with or without ezetimibe and/or PCSK9 mAb, to reach an LDL-C goal <55 mg/dL

claims.text: Statin-intolerant: ezetimibe and/or bempedoic acid or a PCSK9 mAb are options.
claims.quote: In patients unable to tolerate statin therapy, ezetimibe and/or bempedoic acid or a PCSK9 mAb are options to reduce LDL-C levels and ASCVD risk

claims.text: Esp useful w statin-associated musc SE.
claims.quote: Especially useful in patients with statin-associated muscle adverse effects

claims.text: Nexletol: ↓risk of MACE (CV death, MI, CVA, coronary revasc) in adults @ ↑risk who can’t take recommended statin tx.
claims.quote: to reduce the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events (cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, stroke, or coronary revascularization) in adults at increased risk for these events who are unable to take recommended statin therapy (including those not taking a statin)
